The author says Pinot Noir's knockback (밀치기) resistance is strong in the raid and that Bright Seeker is still unproven. Commenters debate Wasabi pet vs AoE pet: Wasabi is steadier on average, but the AoE pet had the higher ceiling for the author because Milky Way had the most stars.

Light element, bow. Possibly 밀키웨이, unconfirmed.

substitutions: Without Bright Seeker: 호밀 was suggested, then 케이크 들개 (the author edited the deck while replying).

mechanics: Pinot Noir's knockback resistance (밀치기 저항) is described as very good in the raid.

posts.summary_en: Video guide by 서신우, the first of a series running through 544G. It scored 7G 165M, rank 1 personal. The deck uses Ceylon Knight, which was then only available through a paid package. After commenter 터리 pushed back, the author replaced 트위즐 with 피겨 and later confirmed that 피겨 had the higher ceiling, so his earlier result was variance. His stats: no skill haste, 38.62% skill amp, of which 26.07% came from gear.

rng: The author's first 피겨-vs-트위즐 test favoured 트위즐. A retest showed 피겨 with the higher ceiling, so the first result was run-to-run variance.
mechanics: Ceylon Knight's skill text says its buff applies only in Guild Conquest ('토벌전 전용 쿠키').
Commenter 파스텔: with 스가 20, 피겨's skill sometimes lines up with an enemy attack and gets cancelled, or cookies get knocked sideways and miss 피겨's buff.
disagreements: 터리 argued 트위즐 was wrong and 피겨 should be in. The author first said 피겨 did less, then retested and agreed.

posts.title_en: Mandatory sugar-rune setup for Jungle Warrior and Pomegranate
posts.summary_en: Mechanics analysis with skill-card screenshots. Jungle Warrior's transform gives 다발 (multi-shot) synergy +3 to nearby allies, and Pomegranate's beam count scales with 다발 synergy. Both skills have a 10 s cooldown. Pomegranate casts first and is too far from Jungle Warrior to receive the first transform's +3, so her second cast gets only Herb's +2 (5 beams). The author therefore gives Jungle Warrior 2–3 more skill-haste lines than Pomegranate, so Jungle Warrior casts first from the second cycle onward. Pomegranate should be all skill amp.

sugar_runes.stats: 스킬가속 required: 2–3 more haste lines than Pomegranate
sugar_runes.why: So Jungle Warrior's second transform (다발 +3) lands before Pomegranate's second cast.

mechanics: Jungle Warrior skill 타이거 라이더 (screenshot): transform cooldown 10 s, 다발 시너지 3, synergy range 3, transform and synergy duration (지속) 7 s, claw attack every 1 s, claw damage 108% of ATK.
Pomegranate skill 석류 추출 (screenshot): cooldown 10 s, red beams (다발) 3. It grants allies 스킬증폭 +69% for 9 s and gives 탄속 시너지 100% for 9 s.
The Pomegranate buff (the 'straw', 빨대) is skill amp +69%, delivered by beams whose count scales with 다발 synergy: 3 at battle start, 5 with Herb's +2, more with Jungle Warrior's +3.

Casting order: Pomegranate casts first at battle start and is too far from Jungle Warrior to get the first transform's synergy. With equal haste, she also casts her second skill before Jungle Warrior.

quotes.kr: 정글전사에는 스킬가속을 무조건 뽑아야하고 석류는 최대한 스킬증폭으로만 세팅해야 합니다.
quotes.en: Jungle Warrior must get skill haste, and Pomegranate should be set as close to pure skill amp as possible.

quotes.kr: 정글전사 슈가룬에 스킬가속을 석류보다 2~3개정도 더 달아두면 될 것 같습니다.
quotes.en: Put about 2–3 more skill-haste lines on Jungle Warrior than on Pomegranate.

posts.summary_en: A no-Ceylon deck at 260.03M power that scored 6,249,890,608 (6.25G, about 24x). Milk is leader, the perk is the all-cookie 2% welfare package Lv2, and pets are 갓방울, Hotdog and Panda. The author set a new best about once every 5 tries. Runes are shown for Melon Soda, Rye, Scorpion (accuracy and focus, the old stage build), Bright Seeker (low star) and Milk (ATK plus skill haste), and Dark Choco (haste plus focus). Jungle Warrior is used over Milky for Scorpion's 다발 synergy, and Hotdog beat the multi-hit pet on average.

posts.summary_en: 서신우's 39.7G video at the start of week 2. The screenshot shows 39G 710M, personal rank 1. This build is a survival-oriented 'raise the floor' setup. The author says the ceiling still comes from the week-1 method: tune ATK so Pomegranate's buff lands, include Cheesecake, and retry without limit. A commenter at 496M power uses the perks 방어구수리특약 and 의료보험 and gets more mid/late damage by surviving longer. The author reports 30.1G on his first try with that.
rng: The ceiling needs 'infinite retries' with ATK tuned for Pomegranate's buff and Cheesecake in the deck. This deck trades ceiling for a higher floor.
mechanics: Survival perks (방어구 수리특약 + 의료보험) let the team survive a pattern that previously killed it, which adds mid/late-fight damage.
disagreements: 첫차는: copying it halved my score. Author: this combo raises the floor for people who don't want hours of retries; the old combo has the higher ceiling.

quotes.kr: 고점은 첫주처럼 석류 버프 받게 공격력 조절하고 치즈 넣은 상태로 무한 리트고 그렇게 몇 시간동안 토벌치기 싫다 하는 경우에 저점을 높여서 끝내는 게 해당 조합이니
quotes.en: For the ceiling, do as in week 1: adjust ATK so Pomegranate's buff lands, include Cheesecake, and retry endlessly. This combo is for raising the floor if you don't want to spend hours.

quotes.kr: 용병단혜택은 방어구수리특약, 의료보험 쓰고있습니다.
quotes.en: (commenter, 496M power) Mercenary perks: Armor Repair Special and Medical Insurance.

posts.summary_en: A Ceylon deck at 422.71M that scored 31,750,253,075 (31.75G, about 75x), with a typical range of 14G–31G. The author says you don't need level resets or ATK ordering, except that Milk must be ATK #1 for 열정페이. Perks are 의료보험 and 열정페이 (mercenary Lv4, Milk leader). 의료보험 exists to survive the big HP hit around the 30 s mark so Milk can heal. Gear: skill haste first on all 6 right-side pieces, with 스증/치확/치피/피감/체력 as secondaries. 딸크 averaged better than 호밀.

scores.note: Guild rank 3, guild 405G 918M. Typical runs are 14G–31G.

teams.perks: Leader 우유. Welfare: 의료보험 (2+ support cookies → ally max HP +5%) and 열정페이 (highest-ATK ally ATK +20%, max HP −20%). Mercenary Lv4 (베테랑 용병단): +1 welfare slot, 거대화 광속질주, 3rd pet slot, leader ATK/DEF/HP +10%. At mercenary Lv3 use the same leader with 공방체 2%.

sugar_runes.why: Milk must be ATK #1 so 열정페이 lands on Milk.

mechanics: Around the 30 s mark the boss takes a big chunk of HP from every cookie. 의료보험 is there so cookies survive on low HP and get healed by Milk.
열정페이 buffs the ally with the highest ATK (+20% ATK, −20% max HP), so Milk must be ATK #1.
disagreements: Commenter asked whether armour (방어구) beats 의료보험; the author says higher HP was more stable.

quotes.kr: 대략적으로 딜은 14G ~ 31G까지 나오는데 레벨초기화나 공순위(우유 제외) 신경쓸 필요없이 쳐도 되는 덱입니다

quotes.kr: 장비는 우측 6개에 스킬가속 우선으로 넣고 다른 보조옵션으로는 스증/치확/치피/피감/체력 챙겼습니다

posts.title_en: Sharing the Cheesecake high-ceiling lottery deck
posts.summary_en: The Cheesecake lottery deck (로또덱), which the author calls the absolute ceiling above the Rye-Melon and Scorpion-Melon decks. You need a run where Cheesecake gives her ATK buff only to Milk and Scorpion. That can take hundreds to tens of thousands of retries; the author played 4,230 runs that season. Pomegranate's targets follow ATK order: Milk > 피겨 > Scorpion (Macaron) > Bright Seeker > Melon > Macaron. She hits 3 targets at first and 6 after one cycle, so whether Macaron gets the first beam swings damage a lot. The post includes full rune screenshots for 10 cookies and a gear preset named SH/CD/SA. The author ended at 26G 160M on 300.39M (about 87x) and says 100–200x is typical and 300x is possible with good fundamentals.

scores.note: Personal 7th. Season ended in 44m 52s. Top guilds that week: 암살자 332G 235M, 파편 312G 985M, 幻想郷の人間の里 295G 674M.

Keep Macaron, Seeker and Scorpion on a slight diagonal so Macaron's crit-rate buff stays up. His stage-geared deck (1G power) scored 108G, and he claims 400x with skill haste above 40.

posts.title_en: Bright Seeker Cookie skill haste research
posts.summary_en: Modelled expected Bright Seeker damage (raid only) for 43 s fights, where the team dies with 17 s left, and 30 s fights, where it dies at the 30 s slam. The model uses three gear baselines, trades rune haste against rune skill amp 1:1, and finds a haste threshold at about 40 total. Crit rate and crit damage runes never beat haste or amp. Recommendations: whales run 8 haste lines, mid spenders target total skill haste 41–45, and F2P players who die at the 30 s slam should go skill amp and crit damage, because haste is negative in 30 s fights. The author's deck (Macaron and Cheesecake on 스증, everyone levelled down to Cheesecake's ATK, Jungle Warrior instead of Herb) scored 339G 975M at 912.73M (about 372x). After Seeker went to 8★ it scored 367G 994M. Last season's max was 250x, and a low-spec variant uses 딸크 and 방어구 수리특약.

scores.note: 'Best ratio' screenshot. Top guilds: 각성 9T 637G, 미르 8T 944G, 킹덤 8T 880G.

sugar_runes.stats: Author's 6 open (★8): 스가 +4.00, 스가 +4.00, 스증 5.00%, 스가 +5.00, 스가 +4.00, 스증 4.70%. Locked ★10: SR 스증 3.20%, C 피감 1.80%. Total raid skill haste 44.6.

sugar_runes.why: The only reason for ATK runes on Cheesecake or Macaron is HP: when dealers are levelled down they die, so raising Cheesecake's ATK lets dealers keep more levels. For damage, 치케 스증 plus dealer level-down is the ceiling.

sugar_runes.stats: 스증 (previously 공증 when spec was lower)

gear.context: raid (arena or raid-dedicated setup, 스증/스가 focus)

mechanics: Above a certain power, most runs last 43 s: the whole team dies with 17 s left, at the super-jump.
SSR top roll on sugar runes: skill haste +5, skill amp +5%. The model treats one slot as +5 of either, so 8 slots give up to 40.

Chart 1 (43 s fight, 40 rune points split between haste and amp, x = haste invested, normalised to x=0 = 100%). Baseline 20/70: about 100.5% at x=5, 104% at 10, 107% at 15, a peak of about 108.5% at 20, a dip to about 107.8% at 26, then about 111.2% at 40. Baseline 27/80: about 105.2% at 8, 106.9% at 15, a drop to 106.4% at 16 (total 43), about 108.8% at 23, then about 111% at 35–40 (marked point about 110.8% at 37). Baseline 35/100: about 103.2% at 5, flat about 104.5% from 8 to 11, about 107.9% at 17, a dip to 107.4% at 18, then about 111.6% at 37 (marked), 111.9% at 39 and 111.8% at 40. All three rise steeply until total haste is about 40, stall, then rise again.

Chart 2 (6★ Seeker, 4 rune slots, 20 points). Baseline 20/70: flat (100 to about 100.6%) until x=5, then linear to about 111% at x=20 (total 40). Baseline 27/80: rises to about 107.6% by x=12–15, drops to about 107% at x=16 (total 43), about 107.8% at x=20. Baseline 35/100: about 103.5% at 5, plateau about 105% at 8–11, about 107.6% at 15, about 108.8% at 17, 108.2% at 18, about 109.4% at 20. Past about 40 total haste, the efficiency of more haste drops sharply.
Chart 3 (30 s fight, base 20/70, 20 rune points): monotonically decreasing, from 100% at x=0 (haste 20, amp 90) to about 96.6% at x=20 (haste 40, amp 70). In 30 s fights skill amp beats skill haste.
+16 haste (four +4 rolls) is barely worse than +20; don't over-reroll.
방어구 수리 특약: 3+ defense-type cookies gives allies +10% damage reduction.

quotes.kr: 치확&치피룬은 아무리 마카롱&피겨를 스킬증폭을 주고 계산해봐도 절대 스킬가속&스킬증폭룬을 이기지 못했습니다.
quotes.en: Crit rate and crit damage runes never beat skill haste or skill amp runes, even when calculated with Macaron and Figure on skill amp.

timeline.event: The 8/27 update is announced: Guild Conquest (boss 지나치게 무거워진 피냐타, dark element, light weakness), Pinot Noir and Bright Seeker.
Launch day. Mixed decks (Wind-archer type, Milky Way, Rye, Pinot multi-hit) score around 120M at about 19M power. Pinot's knockback and lift resistance is noted, and Wasabi vs AoE pet is debated.

Ceylon Knight (paid package; buff works only in Guild Conquest) becomes the centrepiece. 서신우 posts 7.1G. 터리's 'just copy it' deck sets the template: Milk leader, 피겨 instead of 트위즐, pets ATK/skill-amp/Panda, and 'no Ceylon = don't bother'.
Early Seeker decks at 260–302M power. Scorpion is judged essential, and support cookies die too easily.

The Jungle Warrior + Pomegranate synergy is documented: Pomegranate gives +69% skill amp via beams whose count scales with 다발 synergy, and JW gets more haste so its +3 lands first. A no-Ceylon deck reaches 6.25G on 260M (about 24x), with pets 갓방울/Hotdog/Panda and a new best every ~5 retries.
Week 1 ends (inferred from season timers). Top guild totals are around 300G (week-2 screenshot: 332G / 313G / 296G).
Week 2 opens. 서신우 shows 39.7G. The ceiling method is now known: tune ATK so Pomegranate's buff lands, include Cheesecake, retry endlessly. Survival perks (방어구 수리특약, 의료보험) are used to raise the floor.
Most players now own Ceylon Knight, and Ceylon-version decks become standard.
A Ceylon + 딸크 deck with 의료보험/열정페이 scores 31.75G on 423M (about 75x). Milk must be ATK #1 for 열정페이, and gear is skill haste on all 6 right-side slots.

The Cheesecake 'lottery deck' is published as the ceiling. It needs a run where Cheesecake's ATK buff hits only Milk and Scorpion (4,230 runs in one season), with ATK order Milk > Figure > Scorpion > Seeker > Melon > Macaron. The claim is 100–200x typical and 300x possible; the author got about 87x. Gear preset is SH/CD/SA.
All-Lv.100 Ceylon/Cheesecake decks still die after the 30 s slam (about 38x on 278M).
Week 4: the level-down meta is explicit. Dealers are levelled below Macaron so Pomegranate buffs Macaron; 서신우 posts 95.7G.

The 670M guide reaches 216–244x (145G Herb deck, 164G Jungle Warrior deck). It establishes Lv.1 non-carries (Pinot, Dark Choco, Cherry, Scorpion, Herb), skill haste 35 on Seeker and Dark Choco and 25 on others, skill amp 55%, and a Macaron diagonal for its crit buff. Cherry enters the deck. 서신우 posts 169.6G.

The Cherry deck is posted (148 likes). Cherry is used only to straighten the formation for Macaron's crit-rate buff, with five Lv.1 cookies and ATK order Milk > Seeker > Figure > Ceylon > Macaron > Cheesecake. It scores 866G at about 1.2–1.38G (600–700x). The 17 s super-jump is called unsurvivable. The rune and gear table becomes the standard.

Bright Seeker skill-haste research: the threshold is about 40 total haste, the target is 41–45 (44.6 used), and haste is negative for teams dying at the 30 s slam. Cheesecake moves to skill amp and receives the Pomegranate buff, with everyone levelled to Cheesecake's ATK. The deck scores 340–368G at 913M (about 372–403x) vs a 250x max last season. Top guilds are around 9T.
The 9/23 patch adds gear presets and the new pet 색동주머니 (lift resistance), which replaces Panda. Raid-only gear presets with accuracy and focus stripped become common advice.
서신우's 513G haste build: Lv.1 vs Lv.50 on non-carries makes no damage difference; only the straw risk matters.
Pets settle on Wasabi + Hotdog + 색동주머니. 서신우 posts 544.6G using Wasabi-aware ATK tuning, with Pomegranate still alive at 11.4 s: the first image evidence of surviving past the 17 s super-jump.
